answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation. Consider a marble as the anchor of the cost.
